note:
USFS campground in Land Between the Lakes National Recreation Area on Kentucky Lake.  Many sites are lakefront on peninsulas.  --AWH
Five areas (A, B, C, D, T) on wooded ridges and peninsulas, with a swimming beach, two boat ramps reserved for campers, a fishing dock, an archery range and bike trails. About 100 sites go to the seasonal lottery. Water at the sites can be shut off in spring and fall. Some sites take only rigs up to 15-20 ft. --Claude
summary: Kept. AWH lakefront unchanged (report below). Fees 12-42 confirmed (basic up to $16, 50A electric $28). Hookups 50/water/sewer; 368 sites, max 42 ft, pull-throughs. Facilities, season 03-01..11-30, booking via LBL UseDirect (not rec.gov) with fcfs some_sites, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums, 21-day limit. Phone to add: 270-924-2181.
flags: WATERFRONT (--AWH lakefront; report only, not changed): the operator calls it '368 well-defined lakefront and wooded sites', and the UseDirect detail flags C63 ('Lakeside', pad 72x43 ft, max RV 35), B16 ('Lakeside, Difficult turn', basic, max 25) and B17 ('Lakeside', basic, max 25) - the only 'Lakeside' tags among the 138 web-bookable sites (the ~230 FCFS/seasonal sites have no detail). Esri imagery is leaf-off during the winter drawdown; individual pads cannot be resolved under the canopy and Overpass (OSM site points) refused the request (HTTP 406), so no site coordinates. One lidar profile from a pad-like clearing on the west shore of the east bay (36.94369,-88.17488) reaches summer pool (359 ft / 109.4 m) at 44 m, 4.3 m below the start, over a gentle wooded bank - a view by the kayak test if that clearing is a pad. No disagreement asserted; a reviewer wanting certainty should check C63, B16-17 and the C 33-40 / C 63-68 shore on summer imagery.
